description:
Goal: Remove repeated whole-frontier minimum scanning and vector removal shifts from Scheduler::dispatch_changes while preserving exact fact movement, finality and wake semantics. Reuse the existing transient OrderedWorklist rather than introducing a second ordering implementation.

Evidence: committed fz-tfn.48 e616d82d13cc4e916bfae8e5a48e5219ac680d8a and current46 retain scheduler.rs::take_next_fact_change: iter/enumerate/min_by on every selection, then Vec::remove. N independent queued changes require N(N-1)/2 selection comparisons before removal costs. The comparator uses typed fact semantic_cmp then reverse current position, preserving newest-first equal-key chronology. This is algorithmic evidence, not a workload speedup claim. Search of existing tickets finds product-wave49 and subscription-replacement kdt7, neither owns this scheduler selection path.

Strategy: TDD at the production dispatch_changes path; reuse ordered_worklist.rs accepted in48. Preserve dynamically admitted smaller keys and newest-first distinct equal-key movements with explicit transient admission chronology if needed. Ordering is not identity: do not deduplicate distinct movements or invent semantic key/rank caches. Prove any simplification of chronology before removing it. Do not use SharedOrder persistent path-copying trees or add retained scheduler state.

Signal and acceptance: Increasing independent batches prove subquadratic TOTAL insertion/selection/movement work, not comparison-only helper bounds. Extend compiler2_scheduler_fact_frontier_preserves_newest_first_equal_key_chronology (existing [1,3,4,2]) with dynamically appended equal and smaller keys, retractions, reappearance, content/readiness-only changes, coalesced wakes, shared/unreported derivations and final authoritative movement states. Preserve exact typed wake sequences, ground-shift classification, finality, compiler semantic answers, byte-identical artifacts and healthy work pins; allow only proven reductions. Equal/unchanged/unrelated requests add no work. Delete repeated min scanning and temporary probes; document actual final worklist ownership. Relevant complete gates and ticket-scoped cold review before one commit/close, prior-head green CI before push.

Placement: Independent non-blocking epic-tail performance work found during49 preparation; does not block current46 correctness cutover. Blocks final tfn39 acceptance. Product wave49 remains separately scoped; reuse its eventual shared worklist unchanged rather than copy its admission policy (product mutations deduplicate exact pairs; scheduler fact movements preserve distinct chronology). No source or tests changed in this research.
title: Eliminate quadratic scheduler fact-wave selection
